decisions.reason: As a software product that remained visibly marketed after the 2018 launch while similar launches were already removed, it likely reflects a meaningful investment and public commitment that management would be inclined to justify and continue unless failure became unmistakable.

Although newer and therefore less entrenched than A, it fits the firm's automation and control direction, so a medium-sized German machinery firm following escalation of commitment would likely keep backing it and interpret any weak performance as still temporary.
